title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access | TechCrunch
summary: Anthropic is giving employee-level access to six researchers from METR , a nonprofit that tests frontier AI models, to independently assess Anthropic’s models, safety practices, and risk management, the company said in a blog post on Thursday.
